name: consulting-os
description: A 21-skill consulting operating system covering the full engagement lifecycle: problem framing, fact-base building, assumption audits, market sizing, competitive intelligence, customer segmentation, profit-pool analysis, strategic options, pricing, business cases, portfolio review, operating-model design, initiative prioritisation, transformation roadmaps, risk mitigation, war-gaming, KPI architecture, stakeholder alignment, executive narrative, and board memos — plus a meta-skill that sequences the other 20 for any engagement and harvests completed work into reusable IP.
